title: Skill Card
description: A single deterministic skill card derived from a skill's SKILL.md frontmatter and optional skill.meta.json risk metadata. Cards are emitted by scripts/commands/generate-skill-catalog.ts as part of a skill-cards.json catalog.

name.description: Skill name; matches the SKILL.md frontmatter name and the skills/<name>/ folder.

description.description: Short human-readable description from the SKILL.md frontmatter.

useWhen.description: When to use the skill. Derives from metadata.useWhen, falling back to the description.

category.description: Skill category. May be empty when no category is declared.

tags.description: Tags parsed from the metadata.tags CSV.

triggers.description: Invocation triggers parsed from the metadata.triggers CSV.

targetProvider.description: Primary target provider from metadata.target_provider. May be empty.

compatible.description: Compatible provider ids parsed from metadata.compatible_providers.

risk.description: Risk flags read from skill.meta.json when present. An empty object means risk data is absent and should be treated conservatively as unknown.

examples.description: Usage examples. Reserved for future structured sourcing; currently emitted as an empty array.

sourcePath.description: Relative path to the source SKILL.md, anchored under skills/.
